intro: Choosing the right area matters more than the hotel itself in Kanchanaburi. Here are the main neighborhoods, who each suits, and where to book for your travel style.

blocks.html: Short answer: For the classic experience, stay on a River Kwai raft/riverside near the Bridge over the River Kwai. For convenience and budget choose the town center near shops and the market. For nature and waterfalls pick the Sai Yok / Erawan area with resorts and jungle rafts (farther out — you need a car).

faq.q: Is staying on a River Kwai raft worth it?
faq.a: Very much so for a first visit — rafts and riverside stays near the Bridge over the River Kwai are the classic experience, waking up to river and mountain views, from simple rafts to upscale resorts.

faq.q: Where to stay for Erawan Falls?
faq.a: Erawan Falls is about an hour out of town by car. To arrive early and beat the crowds, stay at a resort near Erawan park or the Si Sawat area; otherwise base in town or by the river and drive over.

faq.q: How many days do I need in Kanchanaburi?
faq.a: Two to three days is ideal — for the Bridge over the River Kwai, the Death Railway, Erawan Falls and some riverside downtime. Many come for 1–2 nights from Bangkok.
